summary: Build marine safety, security and environmental compliance skills with ISM, ISPS, and MARPOL. Learn through practical exercises and reporting templates.
lede: Marine compliance and safety training helps marine, port, offshore and terminal professionals assess risks and document controls. They practice Bowtie and HAZID risk analysis, prepare inspection and audit evidence, and apply security and pollution-prevention procedures to support consistent reporting and corrective action across day-to-day operations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already operate in marine, port, offshore, or terminal environments and need a practical way to strengthen safety, security, and environmental compliance. It fits people who manage daily operational controls, prepare audit evidence, supervise contractors, or report marine performance to leadership.
modules: Marine Safety, Security and Compliance Context
prerequisites: You need a working role in marine operations, port operations, offshore support, marine HSE, security, or compliance. Bring current examples such as inspection records, incident logs, permit-to-work templates, environmental checklists, or audit findings if you want to apply the exercises to your own context.
